en.title: Count Palindromic Substrings
en.description:
Given a string consisting only of lowercase English letters, count the occurrences of palindromic substrings in it. Identical content at different positions is counted separately.

The input protocol, examples, and test data are compiled by CSWork based on the original function problem.
en.input: A single line containing the string s, of length 1..5000, consisting only of lowercase English letters.
en.output: Output the number of palindromic substring occurrences.
en.explanation: The output is the result computed according to the problem rules; see the solution for the full algorithm.
hints: Use each character position and each gap between adjacent characters as a palindrome center and expand outward; every time the left and right characters match, you have found one more palindromic substring.
